headline: American Water (NYSE:AWK) Posts Q2 Earnings Beat, Reaffirms Full-Year Guidance
summary: American Water Works (AWK) Q2 earnings beat estimates at $1.61 EPS, revenue nearly inline, guidance reaffirmed, stock up 3.2% weekly.

headline: AMERICAN WATER REPORTS SOLID SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS; AFFIRMS 2026 EPS GUIDANCE AND LONG-TERM TARGETS
summary: American Water Works Company, Inc. (NYSE: AWK) today reported adjusted results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, of $1.61 per share, compared to $1.49 per share for the same quarter in 2025 and $2.62 per share for the year-to-date period ended June 30, 2026, compared to $2.51 per share for the same period in 2025.

headline: American Water Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: American Water Works Company, Inc. (NYSE: AWK) announced that its board of directors today declared a quarterly cash dividend payment of $0.8950 per share of common stock, payable on September 1, 2026, to all shareholders of record as of August 11, 2026.
